svg.text: CE1-D02 / Floor cassette and hardpoint detail
Keep the finished walking surface at Z32.000″ · insulation fits below the existing deck
TOP → BOTTOM IN AN OPEN FRAME BAY
2.5 mm rubber finish + 0.75 mm adhesive budget
3/4″ aluminum honeycomb structural panel
2″ mineral wool below deck, clear of frame
.040″ removable protective aluminum tray
FIXED DATUMS
Finished floor: Z32.000″
Panel top: Z31.872″
Panel underside: Z31.122″
Frame top: Z31.004″ + 3 mm support pad
Wool underside: Z29.122″
Tray underside: Z29.082″
FRAME / FASTENERS / THRESHOLDS
Each panel edge needs support and a sealed closeout; supplier inserts carry point loads without crushing core.
Seat feet and accessible securement loads go into retained steel hardpoints, through isolated sealed sleeves.
No floor insulation is placed between the structural deck and its supports; retain the 3 mm support isolation.
Removable bay trays attach to frame-side brackets and closeouts, not to unsupported honeycomb skins.
Terminate cassettes clear of CI2/CI3 bridges, bolsters, brackets, moving trucks, brake hoses and service paths.
Keep entrance and bridge thresholds flush. The proposed adhesive allowance must match the selected system.
Open honeycomb edges, cutouts and penetrations require sealed closure; floor seams need a compatible seal.
Provisional insulation coverage: 60% of finished floor area.
This deliberately keeps exposed steel in the heat-loss model. Static fit is screened; moving/service clearance is not accepted.
CE1 · 26 OCT 2026 · DIMENSIONED COORDINATION PROPOSAL · NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION
